entities.name: Faltonia Betitia Proba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Faltonia Betitia Proba was a Latin Roman Christian poet. A member of one of the most influential aristocratic families, she composed the Cento Vergilianus de laudibus Christi, a cento composed with verses by Virgil re-ordered to form an epic poem centred on the life of Jesus.
